honesty.label: training scenario, not the project's actual work plan
honesty.authored: Every scenario, step, tool, PPE line, hazard, gate and crew role is AUTHORED general practice, not any site operator's plan and not a standard or a jurisdiction's rule.
honesty.no_remediation: No hands-on hazardous remediation is taught: at the two environmental-monitoring sites the only type is cleanup-support AWARENESS (orientation, boundaries, observation, reporting); entering an exclusion zone or touching material fails the run.
honesty.play: A run is practice. It certifies nothing and never enters a completion record; the completion contract in completion/ is unchanged.
honesty.links: A type sits at a site only where the site's own registry text contains the quoted evidence; crew roles come only from that site's own trade_needs.
honesty.paths: No relief/trades path step links these yet: layers/registry/paths.json holds Louisiana parish stations only, and no Bay station id exists to attach to.

mark the footprint the design drawings show

sweep the area in lines, picking up with grabbers
sort recyclables and trash into separate bags
report and flag anything hazardous without touching it
weigh or count bags and record the tally

safety_gates.text: sharps rule stated (grabber and sharps container only) before the sweep

forbidden.text: opening or moving a drum or unknown container

scenarios.site_name: South Bay Salt Pond Restoration — ecotone levee (Phase 1)
scenarios.title: Ecotone levee - grading a gentle marsh-to-upland slope
scenarios.label: training scenario, not the project's actual work plan

steps.text: crew brief: work area, tide window, haul routes and who signals the machine
set grade stakes and slope limits from the survey layout
place fill in lifts along the levee face, working from the crown
shape the gentle transition slope to the staked grade
check grade against stakes and record the as-built shots
install temporary erosion control on the bare slope

hazards.text: struck-by and caught-between near operating equipment
soft or undercut levee edge giving way under load
incoming tide cutting off the work area

safety_gates.text: spotter and hand signals agreed before any machine moves near people
tide window confirmed and posted before work on the levee face

forbidden.text: riding or standing in a bucket or on a moving machine
backing equipment without a spotter

scenarios.title: Tidal marsh restoration - preparing a diked or managed site for tidal return
scenarios.label: training scenario, not the project's actual work plan

steps.text: crew brief: tide tables, access route on levee crowns, buddy pairs
walk and mark the channel alignment from the design layout
cut starter channels to the marked alignment
place spoil where the plan marks it, never into open water
photo-point and record water levels after the first tides

hazards.text: soft mud entrapment off the levee crown
open water and fast-moving tidal channels
operating equipment on a narrow levee crown

safety_gates.text: tide window confirmed before any work below the levee crown
buddy pairs set and PFDs checked before anyone leaves the crown

forbidden.text: entering the mudflat alone
placing spoil into open water

scenarios.site_name: San Francisco Estuary Invasive Spartina Removal
scenarios.title: Invasive Spartina removal and revegetation (manual and survey work only)
scenarios.label: training scenario, not the project's actual work plan

steps.text: crew brief: tide window, mapped patches and the buddy plan
navigate to the mapped patch and confirm it against the map
flag and record the patch location and size
hand-remove seedlings the crew lead identifies, bagging all plant material
pack out every bag - nothing left on the marsh
plant native plugs where the plan marks revegetation

hazards.text: mistaking native cordgrass for the invasive

safety_gates.text: tide window confirmed before anyone enters the marsh
crew lead confirms identification before any plant is removed

forbidden.text: mixing or applying herbicide (licensed applicators only; not trained here)
leaving removed plant material on the marsh
